Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id. INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3705858'. Keep only rows where standard_relation is not null, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation = '='. Return canonical_smiles, molecule chembl_id as chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Sort ascending by all six output columns. Do not deduplicate; preserve every qualifying activity row.
